description: Queue one research-design turn that may fetch a researcher-provided concept URL and use an external analysis model. A 2026 Tasks client receives a durable task and polls tasks/get; other clients receive a job ID and poll get_customize_study_job. Then call get_study and show the full saved plan for human review. Reuse an idempotency_key after an uncertain response. Native concept images require the synchronous customize_study tool.

concept_image.description: Native images are only supported by customize_study.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.

name: queue_customize_study
title: Queue Study Customization
